# Prior Authorization Agent — Production Runbook

> **Scenario**: Prior Authorization Agent
> **Platform**: Microsoft Copilot Studio — GitHub Copilot harness
> **Target readers**: Makers, delivery engineers, customer or partner operators

**Estimated effort**: Not yet measured; record actual effort on the Frontier Clock.

**Template:** an example to modify for your requirements; the customer or partner wires it into their environment. See the [Overview](1.Overview.md).

## Prerequisites

| Requirement | Details | Owner |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Build workload | 18 captured build checkpoints; 4 skills; 2 knowledge files; 5 acceptance checks; 4 locked cases. [Inventory](2.Architecture.md#copilot-studio-components), [checks](0.Resources/README.md#template-acceptance-checks), and [cases](4.Sample-prompts.md#demo-prompts). | Template |
| Licensing and capacity | Confirm licensing for your tenant and Copilot Credits for the GitHub Copilot harness; building, Preview and evaluation consume credits before publication. | Customer or partner |
| Environment and maker access | Record the approved healthcare environment, publisher prefix and maker access; confirm Claude Sonnet 4.6 is available and keep the workshop Draft. | Customer or partner |
| DLP and data policy | Have the administrator review uploaded knowledge, the proposed EHR or FHIR, payer policy and Teams connections, and channel limits; document blocked paths instead of bypassing them. | Customer or partner |
| Identity and audience | Review the supplied GroupMembership access policy, Integrated authentication and Always trigger; record who may build, test and later use the agent. | Customer or partner |
| Connection ownership | Name owners for each production replacement connection with least-privilege references; the Manual build binds none. | Customer or partner |
| Test identities | Prepare coordinator, nurse case manager, scheduler and denied-access identities for an approved test deployment; makers use Draft Preview. | Customer or partner |
| Tooling by build lane | Manual lane: the Copilot Studio browser and reviewed files. Easy mode: VS Code Agent mode, the Microsoft Copilot Studio plugin and a supported PAC CLI. | Customer or partner |
| Frozen inputs | Use the seven frozen native inputs and locked cases; the historical native import archive cannot reproduce the build. | Customer or partner |
| Minimum-necessary data approval | Have privacy and security owners approve the minimum-necessary evidence fields before live patient data replaces the synthetic records. | Customer or partner |

## Phase 0 — Qualify and Adapt the Template

### Step 0-1. Qualify the outcome and baseline

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Utilization management business owner

Complete the [qualification checklist](1.Overview.md#qualification-checklist).

**Measure:** Evidence gathering, policy checks and reconsideration preparation per authorization request, as done today Establish how evidence gathering and review hand-offs work today before attributing change to the adapted agent.

Fill your baseline record:

| Request | Service type | Evidence items gathered | Missing evidence | Policy version checked | Recorded workflow state | Reconsideration prepared | Reviewer |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |

Agree replacement connections, governance, telemetry, support and success measures before production.

### Step 0-2. Adapt scope and name owners

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Utilization management business owner

Adapt [scope](1.Overview.md#in-scope--out-of-scope) and the [data contract](2.Architecture.md#data-contract); assign approval roles.

| Role | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| Utilization management business owner | Approve evidence and policy sources, review scope and success measures; keep every authorization outcome with qualified reviewers. |
| Qualified utilization reviewers | Own rationale, evidence completeness and outcome, and verify every substantive answer. |
| Copilot Studio maker | Build the frozen r4 inputs with four skills, two knowledge files and zero tools; verify save and reopen and keep the Draft. |
| Power Platform administrator | Confirm tenant licensing, capacity, maker access, authenticated audience and data policies before any clinical connection is approved. |
| Clinical data and policy connection owners | Approve the EHR or FHIR evidence source, payer policy source and Teams coordination; record identities and least-privilege references. |
| Acceptance reviewer | Grade PA-01 through PA-04 once each in fresh chats plus the boundary tests; preserve failures and carry no pass across revisions. |
| Operations owner | Own production support, session and credit monitoring and configuration recovery; route outcomes to qualified reviewers. |

### Exit criteria

- [ ] Replacement connections, governance, telemetry, support and success measures are agreed before production.
- [ ] The utilization owner records how evidence gathering, policy checks, status tracking and reconsideration packets work today before agreeing success measures.

## Phase 1 — Environment, Identity and Access

### Step 1-1. Approve the identity and settings design

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Power Platform administrator

Review and approve the [identity design](2.Architecture.md#identity-and-permissions) and [template settings](../../solutions/prior-authorization/copilot-studio/settings.mcs.yml). Apply agent-specific settings when the agent is built in [Phase 2](#phase-2--build-and-prove-the-agent).

Approve document, connector and channel policies; require authentication and verify blocked routes stay blocked.

### Step 1-2. Configure tenant controls

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Power Platform administrator

Approve the environment, audience and connection identities. Define the [authentication plan](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/configuration-end-user-authentication); configure environment [data policies](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/admin-data-loss-prevention).

### Exit criteria

- [ ] The target environment and approved publisher prefix are recorded before any build lane starts.
- [ ] The authentication option, required sign-in and allowed audience are approved for patient evidence and payer policy.

## Phase 2 — Build and Prove the Agent

### Step 2-1. Choose the build lane

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Copilot Studio maker

| Lane | Suits | Output |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Easy mode with GitHub Copilot (default) | Assisted authoring | Synthetic Draft proof |
| Manual build in Copilot Studio | Browser-only makers | Same Draft proof |
| AIBAST Frontier (experimental) | Portable learning | Behavior proof; native validation follows |

[Compare lanes](1.Overview.md#delivery-lanes); local Brainstem remains optional.

### Step 2-2. Build the selected implementation

**Owner:** Template · **Role:** Copilot Studio maker

**Easy mode:** use the [authoring skill](../../skills/aibast-easy-mode-copilot/SKILL.md) and [reviewed messages](../../solutions/prior-authorization/EASY-MODE-COPILOT-CHAT.md). **Manual:** use the [single inventory](2.Architecture.md#copilot-studio-components) and [tutorial](https://microsoft.github.io/aibast-agents-library/solutions/prior-authorization/manual-tutorial.html) with the checklist below. **Portable learning:** follow [deployment.json](../../solutions/prior-authorization/deployment.json); it does not replace native Draft validation.

**Manual build checklist** — [captured sequence](../../solutions/prior-authorization/screenshots/manual/browserfilm.json). Record current results.

1. Create a blank Copilot Studio agent
2. Name Prior Authorization Manual
3. Enter the reviewed global instructions
4. Save the instruction policy
5. Remove default web search
6. Add knowledge: aibast_prior-authorization-review-rules.md
7. Add knowledge: aibast_prior-authorization-synthetic-records.md
8. Add skill: appeal-evidence-packet
9. Add skill: criteria-evidence
10. Add skill: request-evidence
11. Add skill: status-summary
12. Review model, skills, knowledge, and safety boundaries
13. Open a fresh Preview conversation
14. Pass PA-01: Utilization Management Coordinator
15. Pass PA-02: Nurse Case Manager
16. Pass PA-03: Radiology Scheduler
17. Pass PA-04: Utilization Management Coordinator
18. Confirm Draft and stop before publish

### Step 2-3. Enforce workshop integrity

**Owner:** Template · **Role:** Acceptance reviewer

Apply the [workshop integrity and recovery rules](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery) before replay.

### Step 2-4. Replay the synthetic proof

**Owner:** Template · **Role:** Acceptance reviewer

**Synthetic demo acceptance:** record every locked case: PA-01, PA-02, PA-03, PA-04. Use the [acceptance matrix](4.Sample-prompts.md#per-case-acceptance-matrix) and [template acceptance checks](0.Resources/README.md#template-acceptance-checks).

### Exit criteria

- [ ] All four unchanged locked prompts pass once each in separate fresh Preview conversations on one saved and reopened build.
- [ ] The complete policy, all four skill definitions and both Ready knowledge sources match after reopening the same Draft.
- [ ] If Easy mode is chosen, the source-controlled project uses cli-copilot in the approved environment and stays Draft.
- [ ] If the portable lane is chosen, the recipe smoke test calls `PriorAuthorizationAgent` and returns `SYN-AUTH-001` and `additional evidence requested`.
- [ ] Failures are preserved; a material source change triggers a separately labelled full regression.
- [ ] Only exact personally reviewed references count as visual proof; they are not a continuous fresh-build film.

## Phase 3 — Wire In Your Systems

<a id="shared-integration-controls"></a>

**Shared identity and scope controls**

For each integration, decide end-user versus approved maker/service credentials. [Configure authentication](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/configuration-end-user-authentication) for the [authorized audience](2.Architecture.md#identity-and-permissions).

**Shared scope:** Require sign-in before exposing request evidence or workflow state. Request only minimum-necessary scopes for approved evidence and policy sources. Restrict the allowed audience and verify access with authorized and denied identities. Enforce these restrictions at each connection.

### Step 3-1. Integrate Approved read-only EHR or FHIR evidence source

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Clinical data and policy connection owners

1. **Bind Approved read-only EHR or FHIR evidence source — read:** Bind read-only, minimum-necessary connector or API actions.

2. **Identity for Approved read-only EHR or FHIR evidence source:** Follow the [shared controls](#shared-integration-controls); record the credential choice.

3. **Scope Approved read-only EHR or FHIR evidence source:** Apply the [shared restrictions](#shared-integration-controls); document system-specific limits.

4. **Exit test for Approved read-only EHR or FHIR evidence source:** Record expected and actual results on approved fixtures. [Boundary case 6](4.Sample-prompts.md#routing-and-boundary-cases): Never request or expose live patient information or provide a diagnosis; use minimum-necessary synthetic fields. [Recovery](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery): Stop and route to a qualified utilization reviewer.

### Step 3-2. Integrate Approved payer policy source

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Clinical data and policy connection owners

1. **Bind Approved payer policy source — read:** Add the approved policy source as knowledge with a content owner.

2. **Identity for Approved payer policy source:** Follow the [shared controls](#shared-integration-controls); record the credential choice.

3. **Scope Approved payer policy source:** Apply the [shared restrictions](#shared-integration-controls); document system-specific limits.

4. **Exit test for Approved payer policy source:** Record expected and actual results on approved fixtures. [Boundary case 4](4.Sample-prompts.md#routing-and-boundary-cases): Do not submit or file; a reviewer must confirm that reconsideration or appeal is appropriate and permitted. [Recovery](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery): Report unavailable evidence; never claim a lookup, submission, notification or record change.

### Step 3-3. Integrate Microsoft Teams utilization-review coordination

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Clinical data and policy connection owners

1. **Bind Microsoft Teams utilization-review coordination — read-write:** Gate any review-request workflow behind approval (preview).

2. **Identity for Microsoft Teams utilization-review coordination:** Follow the [shared controls](#shared-integration-controls); record the credential choice.

3. **Scope Microsoft Teams utilization-review coordination:** Apply the [shared restrictions](#shared-integration-controls); document system-specific limits.

4. **Exit test for Microsoft Teams utilization-review coordination:** Record expected and actual results on approved fixtures. [Boundary case 1](4.Sample-prompts.md#routing-and-boundary-cases): Never grant, deny or predict an authorization; a qualified utilization reviewer owns the outcome. [Recovery](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery): Stop and route to a qualified utilization reviewer.

### Step 3-4. Connect

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Clinical data and policy connection owners

Create dedicated read-only connection references with no mutating actions; keep scheduling, outreach and submission out of the agent.

### Exit criteria

- [ ] Approved connections preserve the reviewed input and output contract; no lookup, submission or record change is claimed without tool evidence.
- [ ] Connection references are dedicated and read-only, with no mutating actions.

## Phase 4 — Evaluate on Your Data

### Step 4-1. Adapt the evaluation corpus

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Acceptance reviewer

Preserve [locked behaviors](4.Sample-prompts.md#per-case-acceptance-matrix) and [boundary tests](4.Sample-prompts.md#routing-and-boundary-cases) when substituting approved customer fixtures.

### Step 4-2. Set thresholds and evaluate your data

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Acceptance reviewer

Have the business owner approve thresholds. Run [adapted evaluations (preview)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/analytics-agent-evaluation-intro) before publication under approved test user profiles. Keep exact assertions separate from General quality scores.

Test an approved deployment as intended reviewers and an unshared identity; maker access does not prove user connection access.

### Exit criteria

- [ ] The utilization owner sets customer-data acceptance measures; synthetic states and checklists are not thresholds.
- [ ] Adapted evaluations identify the tested version and user profile; General quality scoring does not replace exact assertions.

## Phase 5 — Pilot and Rollout

### Step 5-1. Review the template release prerequisites

**Owner:** Template · **Role:** Acceptance reviewer

These synthetic regression gates do not set production thresholds. The reference workshop stays Draft; production approval belongs to the customer pilot.

| Template gate | Required evidence |
| --- | --- |
| Locked authorization corpus | All four cases, PA-01 through PA-04, return every required marker, avoid every forbidden phrase and meet the minimum length. |
| Manual inventory and persistence | Two knowledge files, four skills, zero tools and no web search; policy and definitions match after reopening. |
| Clinical and authorization boundary | Any diagnosis, treatment advice, eligibility or authorization outcome, scheduling, outreach, submission or record change is no-go. |
| Source grounding | Any inferred cause for a recorded workflow state that the record does not state is no-go. |
| Release state | The same owned Manual agent remains Draft with `published: false`; Publish was never selected. |

### Step 5-2. Publish and share deliberately

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Utilization management business owner

With business approval, [publish and share](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/authoring-share-agent) the adapted build with a restricted test audience. Keep the reference workshop Draft.

Require explicit confirmation before the production publish operation.

### Step 5-3. Run the governed pilot

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Utilization management business owner

**Pilot entry gate:** Test allowed and denied identities on the published, shared agent; resolve access failures before admitting pilot users. Compare pilot results with the baseline and thresholds; broaden rollout only after go/no-go.

### Exit criteria

- [ ] The production publish operation has explicit human confirmation.
- [ ] The approved utilization-review audience and supported channels are configured and tested before publication.

## Phase 6 — Operate

### Step 6-1. Retain the operational playbook

**Owner:** Template · **Role:** Operations owner

The template provides the [state-and-recovery playbook](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery) and regression cases.

### Step 6-2. Own changes and ongoing verification

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Operations owner

Review content freshness and permissions; re-evaluate source, model, skill or connector changes. [Monitor the deployed agent](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/analytics-overview).

Review utilization session transcripts, failed interactions, connection errors and credit usage in Monitor.

### Step 6-3. Release: ALM

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Copilot Studio maker

Back up the reviewed workspace, pull before editing and pushing, then package with `pac copilot pack`.

### Step 6-4. Release: recovery

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Power Platform administrator

Confirm backup eligibility for the environment type and rehearse restoration to a supported test target.

### Exit criteria

- [ ] The recovery rehearsal uses a restore path supported for the environment type and target.
- [ ] The operator reviews failed sessions, source usage, connection errors and credit consumption after rollout.
- [ ] Payer policy content is re-verified against the current authoritative version whenever it changes.

## Deliverables Checklist

### Template provides

- [ ] Agent, synthetic data and component inventory.
- [ ] Integration/identity contracts and evaluation cases.
- [ ] Build-to-operate playbooks and integrity rules.

### Customer or partner delivers

- [ ] Adapted mappings, identities, governance and connections.
- [ ] Customer-data results, thresholds and go/no-go.
- [ ] Approved publication, operations and recovery.
